text: [61] pañcimā bhikkhave saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā #1 yu. casaddo atthi . 2 po. yu. upajjhāṭṭhānā ... . ma. upajjhāṭhānā licchavi #kumārā apare devati . honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānā katamā pañca aniccasaññā 1 anattasaññā 1 maraṇasaññā āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā 2 imā kho bhikkhave pañca saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti .
